db:info.db:title: IntegralBox Class
db:info.db:subtitle: template <typename T> class IntegralBox
db:info.db:titleabbrev: Test for C++20 concepts and requires clauses

db:abstract.db:para: A box holding any Integral type.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: IntegralBox demonstrates the direct concept-on-template-parameter form: the template parameter T is constrained by the Integral concept without an explicit requires clause.
